entry.title: Global AI Governance Cannot Wait As the Digital Divide Widens
entry.summary:
UNITED NATIONS, July 20 (IPS) - Throughout July 2026, various United Nations (UN) bodies and global experts have underscored the need for increased comprehensive artificial intelligence (AI) governance. Although AI yields significant potential gains for global development, persistent structural barriers continue to impede equitable access and deepen the digital divide.

entry.title: Communities vs. Datacentres
entry.summary:

Across the USA, communities are joining forces across the political divide to oppose developments few want but governments seem determined to impose.

entry.title: Palestine Must Not Disappear
entry.summary:
LONDON, July 20 (IPS) - We have just concluded a visit to the West Bank, Israel, Jordan and Lebanon. From all that we have witnessed and heard, our inescapable conclusion is that the government of Prime Minister Netanyahu, and in particular Ministers Smotrich and Ben-Gvir, aim to make Palestine disappear physically, economically, culturally and politically. Yet other governments either are choosing not to see this or lack the will to take meaningful concerted action.

Read the full story, “Palestine Must Not Disappear”, on globalissues.org →
